Title: Generally Available: Azure App Configuration now offers a Developer pricing plan

Body.Content:
To provide a new flexible and cost-effective option for developers, Azure App Configuration now offers a Developer pricing plan.  

This new plan is ideal for development teams looking for a reliable configuration store for development and testing, and for building prototypes and testing features before moving to production.
Learn more
